# Deferred store-appearance verification (gh-1041).
#
# Owner ruling (2026-09-28): «если получили зеленый саксесс то мы не фейлим
# job а надо заскедулить отдельный job который будет проверять появился ли
# билд в сторах через 1-2 часа» — a green store SUBMIT is final; the store's
# read-side lag (ASC group membership / Play track / pub.dev replica trailing
# an already-successful distribution, #855) must never fail a leg. THIS
# workflow owns appearance instead:
#
#   * scheduled 120 min after the daily publish legs start (05:17 UTC →
#     07:17 UTC) + manual dispatch;
#   * strictly READ-ONLY against all three stores via their real APIs, with
#     the SAME credentials the legs already use — no new secrets (I3);
#   * expected version resolved from the repo's tag/version file every run,
#     so a missed schedule self-heals (I2);
#   * all green → one summary comment on the day's [daily-publish] stubs
#     (once per day per stub — idempotency guard);
#   * absence past the horizon (default 120 min, tunable) → EXACTLY ONE stub
#     per store (label `store-appearance-check`), updated in place by later
#     checks until the version appears or rolls over (AC3).
#
# Check logic: scripts/store_appearance_check.rb — decisions live in
# flutter_app/fastlane/store_appearance.rb, fixture-tested in CI (AC5) by
# flutter_app/fastlane/test/store_appearance_test.rb (plain ruby, ci.yml's
# pre-flight loop) and test/store_appearance_check_test.dart (fake
# endpoints, no real network).
#
# Pause: gh workflow disable store-appearance-check.yml -R IstiN/flutter_agent_harness

name: Store appearance check

run-name: "Store appearance check (${{ inputs.stores || 'all' }})"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 7 * * *' # = daily-publish (05:17 UTC) + 120 min, owner ruling gh-1041
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      stores:
        description: 'Store(s) to check'
        type: choice
        default: all
        options:
          - all
          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
      horizon_minutes:
        description: 'Absence horizon (minutes since the daily legs started) before a stub is filed'
        required: false
        default: '120'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write # stub filing/updates + green-summary comments (same family as daily-publish)
  actions: read # `gh run list` resolves the daily legs' started-at for the horizon gate

# One check at a time; overlapping runs would double-comment.
concurrency:
  group: store-appearance-check
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  check:
    name: Check store appearance
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      # Same credentials the submit legs use (I3 — no new secrets). The check
      # mints read-only API tokens from them; it never uploads anything.
      APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
      APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
      APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
      PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
      # Repo variables shared with the submit lanes (issue #239/#289).
      TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP: ${{ vars.TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP }}
      IOS_BUNDLE_ID: dev.fa1.app
      PLAY_TRACK: beta # the external/open testing track — the daily Play leg's track
      DAILY_PUBLISH_ASSIGNEE: ai-teammate
      STORE_APPEARANCE_HORIZON_MINUTES: ${{ inputs.horizon_minutes || '120' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Check all stores (read-only)
        if: inputs.stores == '' || inputs.stores == 'all'
        run: ruby scripts/store_appearance_check.rb

      - name: Check one store (manual dispatch)
        if: inputs.stores != '' && inputs.stores != 'all'
        env:
          # choice is NOT validated on REST/gh CLI dispatches — route the raw
          # input through env: so it can never become shell syntax (the job
          # env carries real store credentials); ruby validates --only itself.
          STORES_INPUT: ${{ inputs.stores }}
        run: ruby scripts/store_appearance_check.rb --only "$STORES_INPUT"

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Deferred store-appearance check (gh-1041) — the IO half of the goal.
#
# A store SUBMIT that returned green success is final: this job — not the
# submit legs — owns APPEARANCE. Scheduled 120 min after the daily publish
# legs (owner ruling 2026-09-28), it re-checks the three stores READ-ONLY
# (ASC API / Play API / pub.dev API, the legs' own credentials — I3) for the
# expected version resolved from the repo's tag/version file, then:
#
#   * all present   → one green-summary comment on the day's [daily-publish]
#                     stubs (once per day per stub — idempotency, REG);
#   * absent past the horizon (default 120 min) → EXACTLY ONE stub per store
#                     (label store-appearance-check), updated in place by
#                     later checks until the version appears or rolls over;
#   * API error     → reported, never stubbed (noise guard) — the run goes
#                     red but files nothing.
#
# Decisions live in flutter_app/fastlane/store_appearance.rb (plain-ruby
# tested); this script is transport + gh issue lifecycle only. Stdlib only —
# runs on the runner's stock ruby.
#
# Env (all store endpoints overridable for fake-endpoint IT):
#   STORE_APPEARANCE_PUBDEV_BASE   default https://pub.dev/api
#   STORE_APPEARANCE_ASC_BASE      default https://api.appstoreconnect.apple.com
#   STORE_APPEARANCE_PLAY_BASE     default https://androidpublisher.googleapis.com
#   STORE_APPEARANCE_PLAY_TOKEN_URL default https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token
#   STORE_APPEARANCE_NOW / _SINCE / _HORIZON_MINUTES / _RUN_URL   (tests/ops)
#   STORE_APPEARANCE_DRY_RUN=1     compute + print actions, no gh writes
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID/_ISSUER_ID/_KEY_CONTENT, PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
#   TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP, IOS_BUNDLE_ID, PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME, PLAY_TRACK,
#   PUBDEV_PACKAGE, DAILY_PUBLISH_ASSIGNEE
#
# Usage: ruby scripts/store_appearance_check.rb [--only testflight|play|pubdev]

require "json"
require "net/http"
require "tempfile"
require "uri"

SCRIPT_DIR = __dir__
require_relative "#{SCRIPT_DIR}/../flutter_app/fastlane/store_appearance"

S = StoreAppearance

# ── configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def env(name, default = nil)
  value = ENV[name].to_s.strip
  value.empty? ? default : value
end

repo = env("GITHUB_REPOSITORY")
assignee = env("DAILY_PUBLISH_ASSIGNEE", "ai-teammate")
now = env("STORE_APPEARANCE_NOW") || Time.now.utc.iso8601
horizon = S.parse_horizon(env("STORE_APPEARANCE_HORIZON_MINUTES", "120"))
run_url = env("STORE_APPEARANCE_RUN_URL") ||
          (repo && !repo.empty? ? "#{env('GITHUB_SERVER_URL', 'https://github.com')}/#{repo}/actions/runs/#{ENV['GITHUB_RUN_ID']}" : "local")
only = nil
if (i = ARGV.index("--only"))
  only = ARGV[i + 1].to_s.strip
  unless S::STORES.key?(only)
    warn "unknown --only store '#{only}' (want one of #{S::STORES.keys.join(', ')})"
    exit 64
  end
end

root = `git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null`.strip
root = Dir.pwd if root.empty?
pubspec_text = File.read(File.join(root, "pubspec.yaml")) rescue ""
pubspec_version = pubspec_text[/^version:\s*(\S+)/, 1]
publish_to_none = pubspec_text.match?(/^publish_to:\s*none/)
tag_version = `git -C '#{root}' tag --sort=-v:refname 2>/dev/null`.lines.map(&:strip)
             .find { |t| t.match?(/\Av\d+\.\d+\.\d+\z/) }
expected = S.resolve_expected(pubspec: pubspec_version, tag: tag_version)
if expected.nil?
  warn "store-appearance-check: no version source (pubspec/tag) — nothing to check"
  exit 1
end

# ── HTTP helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def http(verb, url, headers:, body: nil)
  uri = URI(url)
  request = Net::HTTP.const_get(verb).new(uri)
  headers.each { |k, v| request[k] = v }
  request.body = body if body
  response = Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: uri.scheme == "https",
                             open_timeout: 20, read_timeout: 60) { |http| http.request(request) }
  [response.code.to_i, response.body.to_s]
rescue StandardError => e
  raise "HTTP #{verb} #{uri.host} failed: #{e.class}: #{e.message.to_s[0, 160]}"
end

def json_response(verb, url, headers:, body: nil)
  code, raw = http(verb, url, headers: headers, body: body)
  parsed = raw.empty? ? {} : (JSON.parse(raw) rescue {})
  [code, parsed, raw]
end

# ── store clients (read-only) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def asc_token(now)
  key_id = env("APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID")
  issuer = [REDACTED:Certificate-DN]
  key = env("APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT")
  return nil if key_id.nil? || issuer.nil? || key.nil?

  S::Jwt.mint(
    header: { alg: "ES256", kid: key_id, typ: "JWT" },
    payload: { iss: issuer, iat: Time.parse(now).to_i - 30, exp: Time.parse(now).to_i + 1100,
               aud: "appstoreconnect-v1" },
    key_pem: key, alg: "ES256"
  )
end

def check_testflight(now, expected)
  base = env("STORE_APPEARANCE_ASC_BASE", "https://api.appstoreconnect.apple.com")
  bundle_id = env("IOS_BUNDLE_ID", "dev.fa1.app")
  group_name = env("TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP")
  raise "TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP is not set" if group_name.nil?
  token = [REDACTED:Sensitive-Value])
  raise "App Store Connect API key is not configured" if token.nil?

  headers = { "Authorization" => "Bearer #{token}", "Accept" => "application/json" }
  code, apps, raw = json_response("Get", "#{base}/v1/apps?#{URI.encode_www_form('filter[bundleId]' => bundle_id)}", headers: headers)
  raise "ASC /v1/apps answered #{code}: #{raw[0, 160]}" unless code == 200

  app_id = S.parse_asc_app_id(apps)
  raise "ASC has no app for bundleId #{bundle_id}" if app_id.nil?

  code, groups, raw = json_response("Get", "#{base}/v1/betaGroups?#{URI.encode_www_form('filter[app]' => app_id, 'limit' => 200)}", headers: headers)
  raise "ASC /v1/betaGroups answered #{code}: #{raw[0, 160]}" unless code == 200

  group_id = S.parse_asc_group_id(groups, group_name)
  raise "ASC external group '#{group_name}' not found (repo variable drift)" if group_id.nil?

  code, group_builds, raw = json_response("Get", "#{base}/v1/betaGroups/#{group_id}/builds?#{URI.encode_www_form('limit' => 200)}", headers: headers)
  raise "ASC group builds answered #{code}: #{raw[0, 160]}" unless code == 200

  code, app_builds, raw = json_response("Get", "#{base}/v1/builds?#{URI.encode_www_form('filter[app]' => app_id, 'filter[processingState]' => 'VALID', 'include' => 'preReleaseVersion', 'limit' => 200, 'sort' => '-uploadedDate')}", headers: headers)
  raise "ASC /v1/builds answered #{code}: #{raw[0, 160]}" unless code == 200

  # #855 semantics: a build is "appeared" only when group membership and the
  # app's VALID build list agree — intersect by build id client-side.
  in_group = S.parse_asc_group_build_ids(group_builds)
  if app_builds.is_a?(Hash) && app_builds["data"].is_a?(Array)
    app_builds["data"].select! { |b| in_group.include?(b["id"]) }
  end
  versions = S.parse_asc_build_versions(app_builds).uniq
  S.decide_presence(expected: expected["app"], observed: versions).merge("observed" => versions)
end

def check_play(root, expected)
  base = env("STORE_APPEARANCE_PLAY_BASE", "https://androidpublisher.googleapis.com")
  token_url = env("STORE_APPEARANCE_PLAY_TOKEN_URL", "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token")
  package = env("PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME")
  if package.nil?
    gradle = File.join(root, "flutter_app/android/app/build.gradle.kts")
    package = File.read(gradle)[/^\s*applicationId\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/, 1] rescue nil
  end
  raise "Play package name not resolvable (gradle + PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME)" if package.nil?

  track = env("PLAY_TRACK", "beta")
  sa_json = env("PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON")
  raise "PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON is not set" if sa_json.nil?

  sa = JSON.parse(sa_json) rescue raise("PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON is not valid JSON")
  now_i = Time.now.to_i
  assertion = S::Jwt.mint(
    header: { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" },
    payload: { iss: sa["client_email"], scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/androidpublisher",
               aud: token_url, iat: now_i - 30, exp: now_i + 1100 },
    key_pem: sa["private_key"], alg: "RS256"
  )
  code, token_res, raw = json_response("Post", token_url,
                                       headers: { "Content-Type" => "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
                                       body: URI.encode_www_form(grant_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer",
                                                                 assertion: assertion))
  raise "Play token endpoint answered #{code}: #{raw[0, 160]}" unless code == 200

  access = token_res["access_token"]
  raise "Play token endpoint returned no access_token" if access.nil?

  headers = { "Authorization" => "Bearer #{access}", "Accept" => "application/json" }
  api = "#{base}/androidpublisher/v3/applications/#{package}"

  code, edit, raw = json_response("Post", "#{api}/edits", headers: headers, body: "{}")
  raise "Play edits.insert answered #{code}: #{raw.to_s[0, 160]}" unless [200, 201].include?(code)

  edit_id = edit["id"]
  begin
    code, track_res, raw = json_response("Get", "#{api}/edits/#{edit_id}/tracks/#{track}", headers: headers)
    if code == 404
      versions = [] # the track exists conceptually but has no releases yet
    elsif code == 200
      versions = S.parse_play_track(track_res)["names"].uniq
    else
      raise "Play tracks.get answered #{code}: #{raw.to_s[0, 160]}"
    end
  ensure
    # Abandon the edit — nothing was committed; this call stays strictly
    # read-only against the store (gh-1041 I3).
    http("Delete", "#{api}/edits/#{edit_id}", headers: headers) rescue nil
  end
  S.decide_presence(expected: expected["app"], observed: versions).merge("observed" => versions)
end

def check_pubdev(expected)
  base = env("STORE_APPEARANCE_PUBDEV_BASE", "https://pub.dev/api")
  package = env("PUBDEV_PACKAGE", "flutter_agent_harness")
  code, payload, raw = json_response("Get", "#{base}/packages/#{package}", headers: { "Accept" => "application/json" })
  raise "pub.dev answered #{code}: #{raw.to_s[0, 160]}" unless code == 200

  parsed = S.parse_pubdev_package(payload)
  versions = ([parsed["latest"]] + parsed["versions"]).compact.uniq
  S.decide_presence(expected: expected["pubdev"], observed: versions).merge("observed" => versions)
end

# ── run the checks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
skips = []
skips << "testflight: App Store Connect key not configured" if env("APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT").nil?
skips << "testflight: TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP not set" if env("TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP").nil?
skips << "play: PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON not set" if env("PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON").nil?
skips << "pubdev: pubspec declares publish_to: none" if publish_to_none

stores = S::STORES.keys.select { |s| only.nil? || only == s }
verdicts = {}
errors = {}
stores.each do |store|
  if skips.any? { |s| s.start_with?("#{store}:") }
    warn "store-appearance-check: skipping #{skips.find { |s| s.start_with?("#{store}:") }}"
    next
  end
  begin
    verdicts[store] = case store
                      when "testflight" then check_testflight(now, expected)
                      when "play" then check_play(root, expected)
                      when "pubdev" then check_pubdev(expected)
                      end
  rescue StandardError => e
    errors[store] = e.message.to_s[0, 300]
    warn "store-appearance-check: #{store} API error — #{e.message}"
  end
end

# ── horizon + gh issue lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def gh(*args)
  out = `gh #{args.map { |a| "'#{a.to_s.gsub("'", "'\\\\''")}'" }.join(' ')} 2>/dev/null`
  $?.success? ? out : nil
end

# Review gh-1041 thread 3: a gh READ failure must be loud — nil degrades to
# "empty state" downstream, which is exactly what files duplicate stubs.
def gh!(*args)
  out = gh(*args)
  raise "gh #{args.first} #{args[1]} failed" if out.nil?

  out
end

# since = when the day's daily-publish legs started (review thread 1: needs
# `actions: read` on the workflow token; review thread 3: a FAILED read
# aborts the lifecycle — it is never "no run found").
leg = nil
since = env("STORE_APPEARANCE_SINCE")
lifecycle_error = nil
if since.nil? && !repo.to_s.empty?
  begin
    leg = S.daily_run(raw: gh!("run", "list", "--repo", repo, "--workflow", "daily-publish.yml",
                               "--event", "schedule", "--limit", "5", "--json", "createdAt,status,conclusion",
                               "--jq", ".[0]"))
    since = leg&.dig("created_at")
  rescue StandardError => e
    lifecycle_error = e.message
    warn "store-appearance-check: #{e.message}"
  end
end
# review thread 5: a daily-publish leg still running at check time has
# possibly not uploaded yet — report only, never stub. review thread 7:
# a leg that ended NON-success never went green — its own [daily-publish]
# failure stub owns the "version missing" signal, not this check.
stub_due = S.stub_due?(now: now, since: since, horizon_minutes: horizon,
                       leg_status: leg&.dig("status"),
                       leg_conclusion: leg&.dig("conclusion"))

dry_run = %w[1 true yes].include?(env("STORE_APPEARANCE_DRY_RUN", "").to_s.downcase) || repo.to_s.empty?
open_stubs = []
publish_stubs = []
summarized = []
unless dry_run || lifecycle_error
  begin
    gh("label", "create", "store-appearance-check", "--repo", repo,
       "--color", "5319E7", "--description", "Auto-filed by the deferred store-appearance check (gh-1041)")
    S.parse_issue_list(gh!("issue", "list", "--repo", repo, "--state", "open", "--label",
                           "store-appearance-check", "--limit", "200", "--json", "number,title"),
                       label: "store-appearance-check").each do |issue|
      open_stubs << issue
    end
    S.parse_issue_list(gh!("issue", "list", "--repo", repo, "--state", "open", "--label",
                           "daily-publish", "--limit", "200", "--json", "number,title"),
                       label: "daily-publish").each do |issue|
      publish_stubs << issue["number"]
    end
    today = now[0, 10]
    publish_stubs.each do |number|
      bodies = gh!("issue", "view", number, "--repo", repo, "--json", "comments",
                   "--jq", "[.comments[].body] | join(\"\\n\")")
      summarized << number if bodies.include?(S::GREEN_SUMMARY_MARKER + today)
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    lifecycle_error = e.message
    warn "store-appearance-check: lifecycle aborted — #{e.message}"
  end
end

# A failed lifecycle read leaves the state partially known: plan NOTHING
# (no stub on unread state, no close on unread state) and go red.
actions = lifecycle_error ? [] : S.plan_lifecycle(
  expected: expected, verdicts: verdicts, stub_due: stub_due,
  open_stubs: open_stubs, publish_stub_numbers: publish_stubs,
  summarized: summarized, run_url: run_url, now: now, errors: errors,
  leg: leg
)

# ── execute the plan ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def write_temp(body)
  file = Tempfile.create(["store-appearance", ".md"])
  file.write(body)
  file.close
  file.path
end

executed = []
write_failures = []
actions.each do |action|
  # review gh-1041 thread 8: a failed gh WRITE must not pass silently —
  # record `done` per action, collect failures, and fold them into `failed`
  # so a partially-executed lifecycle never reports a clean green.
  record = lambda do |ok, extra = {}|
    write_failures << "#{action['action']} #{action['title'] || action['number']}" unless ok
    executed << action.merge("done" => ok, **extra)
  end
  case action["action"]
  when "create_stub"
    next executed << action.merge("skipped" => "dry-run") if dry_run
    body = write_temp(action["body"])
    url = gh("issue", "create", "--repo", repo, "--title", action["title"], "--body-file", body,
             "--label", "bug", "--label", "store-appearance-check", "--assignee", assignee)
    record.call(!url.nil?, "issue" => url.to_s.strip)
  when "comment_stub"
    next executed << action.merge("skipped" => "dry-run") if dry_run
    body = write_temp(action["body"])
    record.call(!gh("issue", "comment", action["number"], "--repo", repo, "--body-file", body).nil?)
  when "close_stub"
    next executed << action.merge("skipped" => "dry-run") if dry_run
    record.call(!gh("issue", "close", action["number"], "--repo", repo, "--comment", action["reason"]).nil?)
  when "comment_summary"
    next executed << action.merge("skipped" => "dry-run") if dry_run
    body = write_temp(action["body"])
    record.call(!gh("issue", "comment", action["number"], "--repo", repo, "--body-file", body).nil?)
  end
end

# ── report ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
failed = errors.any? || !lifecycle_error.nil? || write_failures.any? ||
         verdicts.any? { |_, v| v["verdict"] == "absent" && stub_due }
result = {
  "expected" => expected, "now" => now, "since" => since, "stub_due" => stub_due,
  "verdicts" => verdicts, "errors" => errors, "skips" => skips,
  "lifecycle_error" => lifecycle_error, "write_failures" => write_failures,
  "actions" => dry_run ? actions : executed, "dry_run" => dry_run
}

summary_rows = stores.map do |store|
  display = S::STORES[store]
  if (v = verdicts[store])
    icon = { "present" => "✅", "rolled_over" => "↪️", "absent" => "❌" }[v["verdict"]]
    served = v["observed"].empty? ? "-" : "`#{S.highest(v['observed'])}`"
    "| #{display} | `#{store == 'pubdev' ? expected['pubdev'] : expected['app']}` | #{icon} #{v['verdict']} (serves #{served}) |"
  elsif errors[store]
    "| #{display} | - | ⚠️ API error: #{errors[store].to_s[0, 80]} |"
  else
    "| #{display} | - | ⏭️ skipped |"
  end
end
if (path = ENV["GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"])
  names = (dry_run ? actions : executed).map { |a| a['action'] }
  leg_bits = leg&.dig('status') ? " • leg: #{leg['status']}#{leg['conclusion'] ? "/#{leg['conclusion']}" : ''}" : ''
  bits = +""
  bits << " • LIFECYCLE ABORTED: #{lifecycle_error.to_s[0, 120]}" if lifecycle_error
  bits << " • WRITE FAILURES: #{write_failures.join('; ').to_s[0, 200]}" if write_failures.any?
  File.write(path, <<~SUMMARY, mode: "a")
    ## Store appearance check (gh-1041)

    Expected: app `#{expected['app']}` • pub.dev `#{expected['pubdev']}` • horizon #{horizon} min (legs started: `#{since || 'unknown'}`#{leg_bits}) • stub due: #{stub_due}#{bits}

    | Store | Expected | Verdict |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    #{summary_rows.join("\n")}

    Actions: #{names.empty? ? '_none_' : names.join(', ')}
  SUMMARY

end

puts "STORE_APPEARANCE_RESULT #{JSON.generate(result)}"
exit(failed ? 1 : 0)

# frozen_string_literal: true

# Deferred store-appearance verification (gh-1041): a store SUBMIT that
# returned green success is final — the store's read-side lag (group
# membership / track listing / pub.dev replica trailing an already-successful
# distribution, #855) must never fail a leg. Appearance is owned by the
# deferred `store-appearance-check` workflow (scheduled 120 min after the
# daily publish legs, owner ruling 2026-09-28), and every DECISION it makes
# lives in this module — dependency-free plain ruby (no fastlane, no gems),
# the same contract as VersionFloor/AppstorePreflight/PlayUploadPreflight,
# so the whole matrix is testable with the runner's stock ruby
# (test/store_appearance_test.rb, fixture JSON from
# test/fixtures/store_appearance/ — AC5).
#
# The IO glue (JWT minting, HTTP, gh issue lifecycle) lives in
# scripts/store_appearance_check.rb and stays thin: it fetches the facts,
# this module decides.
require "base64"
require "json"
require "openssl"
require "time"

module StoreAppearance
  # Stores the check owns, in report order. Machine id → GitHub-facing
  # display name (used in stub titles, which double as the idempotency key).
  STORES = {
    "testflight" => "TestFlight",
    "play" => "Play",
    "pubdev" => "pub.dev"
  }.freeze

  # Stub title prefix — every auto-filed appearance stub starts with it, so
  # per-store lookups never need to trust gh search fuzziness.
  STUB_PREFIX = "[store-appearance-check]"

  # Hidden marker inside green-summary comments: at most one summary per
  # publish stub per day, no matter how often the check runs (REG idempotency).
  GREEN_SUMMARY_MARKER = "<!-- store-appearance-check:green-summary "

  # ── JWT minting primitives (stdlib openssl, no gems) ─────────────────────
  # Transport glue the IO script uses to talk to the real ASC / Play APIs
  # with the SAME keys the submit legs already use (gh-1041 I3 — no new
  # credentials). Kept here so the fixture suite exercises real signing
  # without any network.
  module Jwt
    module_function

    def b64url(input)
      Base64.strict_encode64(input).tr("+/", "-_").delete("=")
    end

    # Apple demands a raw r||s (64-byte) ES256 signature; OpenSSL signs ECDSA
    # as DER (SEQUENCE { INTEGER r, INTEGER s }) — unwrap, stripping the
    # INTEGER leading zero a >127-byte-order top byte adds, left-padding
    # each half to exactly 32 bytes.
    def es256_raw_signature(der)
      seq = OpenSSL::ASN1.decode(der)
      unless seq.is_a?(OpenSSL::ASN1::Sequence) && seq.value.size == 2
        raise "not an ECDSA DER signature"
      end

      seq.value.map { |i|
        bytes = i.value.to_s(2) # BN → minimal big-endian magnitude
        bytes = bytes[1..] while bytes.bytesize > 32 && bytes.getbyte(0).zero?
        bytes.rjust(32, "\x00")
      }.join
    end

    def mint(header:, payload:, key_pem:, alg:)
      input = "#{b64url(JSON.generate(header))}.#{b64url(JSON.generate(payload))}"
      raw = alg == "ES256" ? OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(key_pem).sign("SHA256", input) : OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(key_pem).sign("SHA256", input)
      sig = alg == "ES256" ? es256_raw_signature(raw) : raw
      "#{input}.#{b64url(sig)}"
    end
  end

  module_function

  # Strict x.y.z (minor/patch optional) → [x, y, z]; nil for garbage, so a
  # weird store payload can never compare wrong (same contract as
  # VersionFloor.semver).
  def semver(string)
    m = string.to_s.strip.match(/\A(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?\z/)
    return nil unless m

    [m[1].to_i, m[2].to_i, m[3].to_i]
  end

  # a >= b for comparable semvers; false when either side is unparsable —
  # an unparsable observed version is never silently "present".
  def version_gte?(a, b)
    av = semver(a)
    bv = semver(b)
    return false if av.nil? || bv.nil?

    (av <=> bv) >= 0
  end

  # The highest comparable version in a store response — the evidence the
  # report/stub quotes ("pub.dev serves 1.0.484").
  def highest(versions)
    versions.map { |v| [semver(v), v] }.compact.max_by { |sv, _| sv }&.last
  end

  # ── Expected version resolution ───────────────────────────────────────────
  # The repo's tag/version file is the source of truth (one-version scheme,
  # gh-785: auto_release bumps pubspec + tags vX.Y.Z atomically, the daily
  # legs build/attach exactly that train). Resolving the LATEST expectation
  # every run is what makes a missed/skipped schedule self-heal (gh-1041 I2):
  # the check never needs yesterday's run id.
  #
  #   pubspec — root pubspec.yaml version (what the tag-publish publishes)
  #   tag     — newest vX.Y.Z tag (what the mobile/desktop builds stamp)
  # Returns { "app" => x.y.z (TestFlight/Play expectation),
  #           "pubdev" => x.y.z (pub.dev expectation) } or nil when nothing
  # is resolvable (fresh repo without any version source).
  def resolve_expected(pubspec:, tag:)
    pubspec_v = semver(pubspec) && pubspec.to_s.strip
    tag_v = tag.to_s.strip.sub(/\Av/, "")
    tag_v = semver(tag_v) && tag_v
    candidates = [pubspec_v, tag_v].compact
    return nil if candidates.empty?

    app = highest(candidates)
    { "app" => app, "pubdev" => pubspec_v || app }
  end

  # ── Presence verdict (the AC4 contract — identical for all three stores) ──
  # present     — the store serves >= the expected version (equal = appeared)
  # rolled_over — the store serves only NEWER versions than expected: a later
  #               train already superseded it, so the absence is moot
  # absent      — nothing >= expected is served
  # matched     — the highest observed version that satisfies the verdict
  def decide_presence(expected:, observed:)
    satisfying = observed.to_a.select { |v| version_gte?(v, expected) }
    matched = highest(satisfying)
    if matched.nil?
      { "verdict" => "absent", "matched" => nil }
    elsif semver(matched) == semver(expected)
      { "verdict" => "present", "matched" => matched }
    else
      { "verdict" => "rolled_over", "matched" => matched }
    end
  end

  # ── Absence horizon (AC3) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Absence only files a stub once the horizon (default 120 min, owner
  # ruling) has elapsed since the day's publish legs STARTED — an early
  # manual run reports "absent" without filing. since = the daily-publish
  # scheduled run's created_at; now is injectable for tests.
  #
  # leg_status (review gh-1041 thread 5): when the day's daily-publish run is
  # STILL running at check time, its build may not even be uploaded yet
  # (TestFlight worst case ≈ 220 min after start) — stubbing then is a false
  # positive by construction, so the check reports only and a later check
  # (next day, or a manual re-run) owns the stub.
  def stub_due?(now:, since:, horizon_minutes:, leg_status: nil, leg_conclusion: nil)
    return false if %w[in_progress queued pending waiting].include?(leg_status.to_s)
    # review gh-1041 thread 7: `completed` alone is not "the submit went
    # green" — a failed/cancelled/timed-out leg never uploaded, so an
    # absence stub's premise ("a green submit's version should be live")
    # doesn't hold; the leg's own [daily-publish] failure stub owns that
    # signal. Any KNOWN non-success conclusion → report only. A missing
    # conclusion (old gh shape, manual dispatch) keeps the old semantics.
    return false if !leg_conclusion.nil? && leg_conclusion != "success"

    return true if since.nil? # no daily run found — a manual check owns the horizon itself

    started = Time.iso8601(since.to_s) rescue nil
    now_t = Time.iso8601(now.to_s) rescue nil
    return true if started.nil? || now_t.nil? # unparsable clock — fail loud, not silent

    (now_t - started) >= horizon_minutes.to_i * 60
  end

  # horizon_minutes arrives as a free-text dispatch input — a non-numeric or
  # non-positive value must fall back to the default, never collapse to 0
  # ("stub immediately") via Integer#to_i (review gh-1041, minor).
  def parse_horizon(raw, default: 120)
    value = Integer(raw.to_s.strip) rescue nil
    value.nil? || value <= 0 ? default : value
  end

  # ── gh output parsing (review gh-1041 threads 1/3: reads fail LOUD) ───────
  # A `gh` READ failure must abort the lifecycle phase, never degrade to
  # "empty state" — an empty stub list read from a failed gh call is what
  # files DUPLICATE stubs (AC3's exactly-one guarantee).

  # `gh run list --json createdAt,status,conclusion --jq '.[0]'` output →
  # { "created_at" =>, "status" =>, "conclusion" => } for the day's
  # daily-publish run; nil when there is no scheduled run (quiet day).
  # raw nil = the gh call itself failed → raise.
  def daily_run(raw:)
    raise "gh run list failed — cannot resolve the legs' start time (aborting, not treating as 'no run found')" if raw.nil?

    parsed = JSON.parse(raw.to_s) rescue nil
    return nil if parsed.nil? || !parsed.is_a?(Hash) # empty/null output = no run found

    {
      "created_at" => parsed["createdAt"].is_a?(String) ? parsed["createdAt"] : nil,
      "status" => parsed["status"].is_a?(String) ? parsed["status"] : nil,
      "conclusion" => parsed["conclusion"].is_a?(String) ? parsed["conclusion"] : nil,
    }
  end

  # `gh issue list --json number,title` output → [{ "number" =>, "title" => }].
  # raw nil (gh failed) or unparsable output → raise; the caller skips the
  # whole lifecycle rather than planning against partially-read state.
  def parse_issue_list(raw, label:)
    raise "gh issue list (#{label}) failed — aborting the lifecycle instead of reading it as 'no open issues'" if raw.nil?

    parsed = JSON.parse(raw.to_s) rescue nil
    raise "gh issue list (#{label}) returned unparsable output — aborting the lifecycle" unless parsed.is_a?(Array)

    parsed.filter_map do |issue|
      next nil unless issue.is_a?(Hash) && issue["number"].is_a?(Integer)

      { "number" => issue["number"], "title" => issue["title"].is_a?(String) ? issue["title"] : "" }
    end
  end

  # ── ASC payload parsers (recorded /v1 responses, AC5) ────────────────────
  # GET /v1/apps?filter[bundleId]=… → the app id; nil when ASC knows no app.
  def parse_asc_app_id(json)
    data = json.is_a?(Hash) && json["data"].is_a?(Array) ? json["data"] : []
    data.first.is_a?(Hash) && data.first["id"].is_a?(String) ? data.first["id"] : nil
  end

  # GET /v1/betaGroups?filter[app]=… → id of the group named exactly +group_name+
  # (fastlane/pilot resolves by name the same way — a renamed group is a
  # config error, never a false "absent").
  def parse_asc_group_id(json, group_name)
    data = json.is_a?(Hash) && json["data"].is_a?(Array) ? json["data"] : []
    group = data.find do |g|
      g.is_a?(Hash) && g.dig("attributes", "name") == group_name
    end
    group && group["id"].is_a?(String) ? group["id"] : nil
  end

  # GET /v1/betaGroups/{id}/builds → membership set (build ids in the group).
  def parse_asc_group_build_ids(json)
    data = json.is_a?(Hash) && json["data"].is_a?(Array) ? json["data"] : []
    data.filter_map { |b| b.is_a?(Hash) && b["id"].is_a?(String) ? b["id"] : nil }
  end

  # GET /v1/builds?filter[app]=…&include=preReleaseVersion (VALID only) →
  # marketing versions, joined from the builds' preReleaseVersion relation
  # (the Fastfile's verify_external_distribution! does the same join — the
  # list endpoint ships no usable app_version without the include).
  def parse_asc_build_versions(json)
    data = json.is_a?(Hash) && json["data"].is_a?(Array) ? json["data"] : []
    included = json.is_a?(Hash) && json["included"].is_a?(Array) ? json["included"] : []
    prerelease = {}
    included.each do |row|
      next unless row.is_a?(Hash) && row["type"] == "preReleaseVersions"

      v = row.dig("attributes", "version")
      prerelease[row["id"]] = v if v.is_a?(String)
    end
    data.filter_map do |b|
      next nil unless b.is_a?(Hash)
      next nil unless b.dig("attributes", "processingState") == "VALID"

      rel = b.dig("relationships", "preReleaseVersion", "data", "id")
      prerelease[rel]
    end.compact
  end

  # ── Play payload parser ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # GET /androidpublisher/v3/.../edits/{id}/tracks/{track} → version NAMES
  # of the track's releases (Play names bundle releases after the versionName;
  # versionCodes ride along for the evidence block).
  def parse_play_track(json)
    releases = json.is_a?(Hash) && json["releases"].is_a?(Array) ? json["releases"] : []
    names = []
    codes = []
    releases.each do |r|
      next unless r.is_a?(Hash)

      names << r["name"] if r["name"].is_a?(String)
      (r["versionCodes"].is_a?(Array) ? r["versionCodes"] : []).each do |c|
        codes << c.to_s
      end
    end
    { "names" => names, "versionCodes" => codes }
  end

  # ── pub.dev payload parser ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # GET /api/packages/<pkg> → latest + all served versions (a replica can lag
  # latest while still listing the version — compare against BOTH, AC4).
  def parse_pubdev_package(json)
    return { "latest" => nil, "versions" => [] } unless json.is_a?(Hash)

    latest = json.dig("latest", "version")
    versions = (json["versions"].is_a?(Array) ? json["versions"] : [])
               .filter_map { |v| v.is_a?(Hash) && v["version"].is_a?(String) ? v["version"] : nil }
    { "latest" => latest.is_a?(String) ? latest : nil, "versions" => versions }
  end

  # ── Issue lifecycle planner (AC3 — the whole thing is a pure function) ────
  # Inputs:
  #   expected          — resolve_expected output
  #   verdicts          — { "testflight" => decide_presence output, ... }
  #                       (stores that were skipped are simply absent)
  #   errors            — { "testflight" => "ASC answered 500 …", ... }: an
  #                       API error blocks the green summary (an unchecked
  #                       store must never be reported as "all green")
  #   stub_due          — Horizon.stub_due? result
  #   open_stubs        — open issues labeled store-appearance-check:
  #                       [{ "number" => 12, "title" => "[store-appearance-check] …" }]
  #   publish_stub_numbers — open [daily-publish] leg-failure stubs that get
  #                       the green summary comment
  #   summarized        — publish stub numbers that ALREADY carry today's
  #                       green-summary marker (idempotency, REG)
  #   run_url           — this check run's URL (evidence in every body)
  #   now               — RFC3339 stamp for bodies
  # Returns actions; the IO script executes them via gh verbatim:
  #   create_stub / comment_stub / close_stub / comment_summary
  def plan_lifecycle(expected:, verdicts:, stub_due:, open_stubs:, publish_stub_numbers:, summarized:, run_url:, now:, errors: {}, leg: nil)
    actions = []
    STORES.each do |store, display|
      verdict = verdicts[store]
      next if verdict.nil? # skipped or errored — never stubbed, never resolved

      expected_version = store == "pubdev" ? expected["pubdev"] : expected["app"]
      exact_title = "#{STUB_PREFIX} #{display} #{expected_version} absent"
      prefix = "#{STUB_PREFIX} #{display} "
      store_stubs = open_stubs.select { |s| s["title"].to_s.start_with?(prefix) }
      exact_stub = store_stubs.find { |s| s["title"] == exact_title }
      stale_stubs = store_stubs.reject { |s| s == exact_stub }

      case verdict["verdict"]
      when "present", "rolled_over"
        store_stubs.each do |stub|
          reason = if verdict["verdict"] == "rolled_over"
                     "store now serves #{verdict['matched']} (> expected #{expected_version}) — resolved by version rollover"
                   else
                     "#{expected_version} appeared (store serves #{verdict['matched']}) — resolved"
                   end
          actions << { "action" => "close_stub", "number" => stub["number"],
                       "store" => store, "reason" => reason }
        end
      when "absent"
        # A stale stub (expectation moved on, still absent) is superseded by
        # the current expectation's stub — exactly one live stub per store.
        stale_stubs.each do |stub|
          actions << { "action" => "close_stub", "number" => stub["number"],
                       "store" => store,
                       "reason" => "expectation rolled over to #{expected_version} (still absent) — superseding this stub" }
        end
        if stub_due
          body = absence_body(
            display: display, version: expected_version, verdict: verdict,
            run_url: run_url, now: now, updated: !exact_stub.nil?, leg: leg
          )
          if exact_stub
            actions << { "action" => "comment_stub", "number" => exact_stub["number"],
                         "store" => store, "title" => exact_title, "body" => body }
          else
            actions << { "action" => "create_stub", "store" => store,
                         "title" => exact_title, "body" => body }
          end
        end
      end
    end

    # A green summary only when nothing errored (an unchecked store must
    # never be reported "all green"), EVERY store in the family produced a
    # verdict (review gh-1041 thread 2: a partial --only run must not post
    # "live in all stores" — nor burn the day's idempotency marker the
    # scheduled full check needs), and every ran store is resolved.
    if errors.empty? &&
       STORES.keys.all? { |s| verdicts.key?(s) } &&
       verdicts.values.all? { |v| %w[present rolled_over].include?(v["verdict"]) }
      publish_stub_numbers.each do |number|
        next if summarized.include?(number)

        actions << { "action" => "comment_summary", "number" => number,
                     "body" => green_summary_body(expected: expected, verdicts: verdicts, run_url: run_url, now: now) }
      end
    end
    actions
  end

  def absence_body(display:, version:, verdict:, run_url:, now:, updated:, leg: nil)
    observed = verdict["observed"] || []
    top = highest(observed)
    served = if top.nil?
               '_nothing comparable_'
             else
               older = observed.length - 1
               "`#{top}`#{older.positive? ? " (+#{older} older versions)" : ''}"
             end
    # review gh-1041 thread 7: the day's leg state is part of the evidence —
    # the stub's premise is "a green submit's version should be live".
    leg_line = leg.is_a?(Hash) && leg["status"].is_a?(String) &&
               !leg["status"].empty? ? "      - **Submit leg at check time:** `#{leg['status']}`#{leg['conclusion'].to_s.empty? ? '' : " / `#{leg['conclusion']}`"}\n" : ""
    <<~BODY
      #{STUB_PREFIX} **#{display}**: expected `#{version}` is still **absent** past the horizon.

      - **Expected:** `#{version}` (resolved from the repo tag/version file — gh-1041 I2)
      - **Store serves:** #{served}
#{leg_line}      - **First check runs 120 min after the daily publish legs start; this stub is updated in place by later checks until the version appears or rolls over (exactly-one-stub guarantee).**
      - **Check run:** #{run_url}
      - **Checked at:** #{now}

      _Auto-filed by `store-appearance-check` (gh-1041) — auto-closes when the version appears. Reuses the submit legs' credentials; strictly read-only against the stores._
    BODY
  end

  def green_summary_body(expected:, verdicts:, run_url:, now:)
    rows = STORES.filter_map do |store, display|
      v = verdicts[store]
      next nil if v.nil?

      expected_version = store == "pubdev" ? expected["pubdev"] : expected["app"]
      icon = v["verdict"] == "present" ? "✅" : "↪️"
      "| #{display} | `#{expected_version}` | #{icon} #{v['verdict']} (serves `#{v['matched']}`) |"
    end
    <<~BODY
      #{GREEN_SUMMARY_MARKER}#{now.to_s[0, 10]} -->

      **Store appearance check — all green.** The versions the daily publish legs shipped are live in all stores:

      | Store | Expected | Verdict |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      #{rows.join("\n")}

      Check run: #{run_url} • checked at #{now}

      _Posted once per day per stub (idempotency guard); appearance failures surface as their own `[store-appearance-check]` stub, never as a failed submit leg (gh-1041)._
    BODY
  end
end

---

# Daily auto-publish (issue #161): thin orchestrator over the existing
# publish channels. Each channel is an isolated leg — one leg failing never
# kills the others — and every failure self-files a deduplicated GitHub
# issue (label `bug`, assigned to the owner) that auto-closes when the leg
# goes green again. No publish logic is duplicated here: legs dispatch the
# existing workflows via `gh workflow run` and watch them.
#
#   testflight  build-mobile.yml   ios_content=all (the iOS half of the
#                                 mobile build)
#   play        build-mobile.yml   android_content=all,
#                                 android_track=beta (Android external
#                                 beta / open testing — issue #289 lifts
#                                 the standing "Android excluded" owner
#                                 decision for the release track; #947
#                                 adds the listing deploy — texts +
#                                 whole-set image replace + verify — so
#                                 the listing never trails the goldens;
#                                 the leg green-skips while the Play
#                                 secrets are absent)
#   pubdev      in-job OIDC publish, only when pubspec > pub.dev; otherwise
#               a green up-to-date check. The tag-time OIDC publish job
#               (ci.yml) stays the primary path; this leg is the catch-up +
#               loud-failure detector (e.g. expired publish credentials)
#   cli         build-macos.yml    desktop DMG + macOS CLI bundles +
#                                 extension, attached to the next-tag
#                                 release (version passed explicitly so
#                                 mobile/desktop never mint diverging tags)
#   windows     build-windows.yml windows-x64 app zip (fa-app-windows-x64.zip,
#                                 stable name), attached to the next-tag
#                                 release — the Windows counterpart of the
#                                 TestFlight leg: one release-quality GUI
#                                 app build per day (gh-2140)
#   website     pages.yml          fa1.dev (landing + web demo +
#                                 the /outlook add-in slice; gh-1684:
#                                 the extension zip moved to GitHub
#                                 Releases and is no longer site-hosted)
#   addin       office-addin.yml   manifest/taskpane acceptance suite; the
#                                 fa1.dev publish itself rides the website
#                                 leg (pages.yml assembles /outlook)
#
# Legs run only when main moved since the last GREEN daily run — skip-no-
# change is green-neutral, never red (#159 lesson). One exception (gh-1192):
# while main's pubspec version is not yet served by pub.dev the plan gate
# (scripts/daily_plan.sh) forces the legs anyway — a release-in-flight
# green must not become a skip baseline that stalls re-verification and
# rerun-recovery on a quiet main. Versioning stays the
# existing scheme: auto_release.sh patch-bumps + tags every main push
# (2h coalesce); the daily attaches mobile/desktop artifacts to the next
# tag and verifies/republishes pub.dev. See docs/ci.md.
#
# Pause: gh workflow disable daily-publish.yml -R IstiN/flutter_agent_harness

name: Daily auto-publish

run-name: "Daily auto-publish (${{ inputs.legs || 'all' }})"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 5 * * *' # once daily, 05:17 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      legs:
        description: 'Leg(s) to run'
        type: choice
        default: all
        options:
          - all
          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
          - cli
          - windows
          - website
          - addin
      force:
        description: 'Run even if main has not moved since the last green daily'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      inject_failure:
        description: 'TEST ONLY — fail this leg before any dispatch, to exercise the self-filing issue cycle'
        type: choice
        default: none
        options:
          - none
          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
          - cli
          - windows
          - website
          - addin

permissions:
  contents: read

# One daily at a time; a queued run must not cancel an in-flight one.
concurrency:
  group: daily-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  plan:
    name: Plan (change detection + versions)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1477: 10m was the same time bomb as the derive-version jobs — a
    # full-history fetch under a 10m ceiling. 20m + the blobless filter
    # below.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    outputs:
      changed: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.changed }}
      next_tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.next_tag }}
      latest_tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.latest_tag }}
      pubspec_version: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.pubspec_version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1477: daily_plan.sh reads tags / commit metadata / one file
          # at origin/main — never historical blobs. Blobless keeps full
          # tag/commit metadata without the blobs (the full fetch outgrew
          # the old 10m ceiling in the twin derive-version job, run
          # 38027695551).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Detect main movement and derive versions
        id: plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
        # gh-1192: the gate (baseline + the release-unresolved re-arm that
        # keeps AC1's «the next daily re-verifies» true on a quiet main)
        # lives in the extracted script — shell-harness tested by
        # test/release_flow_race_test.dart.
        run: bash scripts/daily_plan.sh

  # ── Dispatch legs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Shape per leg: dispatch the child workflow pinned to main, capture the
  # new run id, wait for it read-only, fail on any non-success conclusion.
  # The child run URL is exported even on failure so the report can excerpt
  # its log.
  #
  # ── The gh-1903 invariant: queued on the single self-hosted runner is
  # HEALTHY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # dispatch_and_watch.sh NEVER cancels or re-dispatches a child mid-watch.
  # A child queued behind siblings on the shared fa-m5-1 is normal
  # operation; the old #344 budget + gh-172 queue-stall watchdog cancelled
  # two such healthy queued children on 2026-10-26 (daily run 40274465122,
  # tracking issue #1735 — those cancellations were THIS defect, not an
  # ASC/IPA problem) and failed a fully-built v1.0.648 solely by killing
  # its place in line. What bounds a slow child instead:
  #   * every job in a watched child chain carries an explicit
  #     timeout-minutes — a wedged self-hosted job self-fails server-side
  #     (#344; a job-level timeout is enforced BY the runner, which is why
  #     a hung worker outliving its own ceiling is the one class the
  #     server cannot kill), and
  #   * the leg timeout-minutes below — when it fires, the runner TERMs
  #     the watcher, which cancels ONLY this leg's own NEVER-STARTED child
  #     (gh-1903 orphan-cancel) so an orphaned queued run cannot publish
  #     unattended, then fails naming the child run, its last observed
  #     state, and the observed pool activity (gh-172 diagnostic).
  # While the child has not started, the watcher logs sibling in-progress
  # runs on a diagnostic interval — read-only; cannot-observe ⇒
  # cannot-judge ⇒ never a cancel.
  #
  # ── Timeout arithmetic (#351, leg-timeout sizing) ────────────────────────
  # Child worst-case = sum of the serialized job timeout-minutes along the
  # child's critical path (every job in a watched chain carries an explicit
  # timeout for exactly this). Invariant: leg timeout > child worst-case +
  # margin (appear window 60×10s ≈ 10m + poll slack ≈ 5m) — the leg always
  # outlives a healthy slow child, which is now NEVER killed.
  #
  #   leg        child worst-case (serialized chain)          leg timeout
  #   testflight version 20 → build-ios 90 → submit-ios 120   230m  ;  360m
  #             (∥ release-mobile 15, covered by the max)
  #   play       version 20 → build-android 45 →              95m   ;  240m
  #             submit-android 30 (∥ release-mobile 15)
  #   cli        version 20 → build-macos 150×2 (arm64 +      335m  ;  360m
  #             x86_64 SERIALIZE on the single self-hosted
  #             runner) → release-macos 15
  #             (∥ cli matrix 45, extension 30 — shorter paths)
  #   (gh-1477: the version/plan jobs' ceiling moved 10 → 20m — a
  #   full-history fetch outgrew the 10m bomb; the fetch is now blobless
  #   and 20m is the seatbelt. Worst-cases grew by exactly the +10m.)
  #   website    pages build 45 → deploy 15                   60m   ;  180m
  #   addin      office-addin-suite 45 (single job)           45m   ;  150m
  #
  # gh-172 (run 39374894901, 2026-10-20) history: the re-dispatched
  # testflight child sat queued FOREVER on the zombie self-hosted worker —
  # the leg burned its remaining ~107m and died as a bare 360m ceiling
  # kill with no diagnosis. The budget/stall watchdog built to catch that
  # faster could not tell a zombie-held pool from a sibling leg's job
  # legitimately occupying the shared fa-m5-1 (its own comment admitted
  # it), and its 31m stall window did not cover the cli sibling chain's
  # 335m worst-case — so it false-cancelled healthy queues by design
  # (gh-1903, #1735). The zombie goal is now met by the bounds above plus
  # the leg-timeout orphan-cancel diagnostic, not by a heuristic that
  # cannot tell a queue from a zombie.

  testflight:
    name: 'Leg: TestFlight'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 230m (version 20 + build-ios 90 +
    # submit-ios 120); 360m leg > worst-case + ~15m margin. The 360m cap
    # also bounds any gh-172 zombie wait — on leg timeout the watcher's
    # orphan-cancel kills only this leg's never-started child (gh-1903).
    timeout-minutes: 360
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'testflight')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'testflight'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=testflight) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      - name: Dispatch build-mobile.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Shared watcher (gh-1903, correlation from #343): correlates
          # OUR run by the child's run-name ("build-mobile (none/all)" —
          # displayTitle is the only distinguisher in the run-list API),
          # newest match in a tight window. Waits READ-ONLY: a child
          # queued behind siblings on the shared fa-m5-1 is healthy and is
          # never cancelled/re-dispatched; the bounds are build-ios/
          # submit-ios's own timeout-minutes (#344) and this leg's 360m.
          # On leg timeout the watcher cancels only this leg's own
          # never-started orphan child (gh-1903) — see the leg-header
          # comment for the full invariant.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-mobile.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-mobile (none/all)' \
            -f android_content=none -f ios_content=all \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  play:
    name: 'Leg: Play (Android external beta)'
    # Independent of the testflight leg (#359). The #348 serialization was
    # a mitigation for the #343 sibling-dispatch race; #351 eliminated that
    # race structurally — exact displayTitle correlation (this leg's child
    # runs as "build-mobile (all/none)", the testflight leg's as
    # "(none/all)"), NEWEST match, a tight 30s window, and build-mobile's
    # per-run_id concurrency group (no dispatch can cancel another). With
    # the race gone the needs-edge only bought harm: a cancelled testflight
    # watcher skipped Play behind it and the edge added up to 360m of start
    # latency (one leg's external blocker stopped the train — run
    # 34827074052, BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL user-owned).
    #
    # The two residual #346 concerns are handled structurally, not by
    # ordering:
    #   * same-tag convergence — both children independently derive
    #     latest-tag+1, so they can attach to ONE release concurrently;
    #     release_attach_or_create.sh is race-idempotent (a lost create
    #     uploads into the winner's release) with an ownership-scoped draft
    #     guard, and the asset sets never collide (AAB vs IPA).
    #   * runner contention — none: the Android chain is all GitHub-hosted
    #     runners; only build-ios touches the single self-hosted macOS
    #     runner (which already serializes physically with the cli leg's
    #     build-macos children — that pair has always been independent).
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic (unchanged by #359 — only the leg's START moved):
    # child wc 95m (version 20 + build-android 45 + submit-android 30);
    # 240m leg > worst-case + ~15m margin. Waits are read-only (gh-1903) —
    # no cancel, no re-dispatch, bounded by the child's per-job timeouts
    # (#344) and this leg timeout.
    timeout-minutes: 240
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'play')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      # Secrets presence is checked in the first step — while the Play
      # upload keystore/service account are not configured, the leg green-
      # skips with a notice (existing neutral-skip leg semantics); it goes
      # live the moment the owner sets them (issue #289).
      PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
      ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
      ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'play'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=play) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      - name: Skip without Play secrets (green-neutral)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          missing=""
          [ -z "${ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64:-}" ] && missing="$missing ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64"
          [ -z "${ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:-}" ] && missing="$missing ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"
          [ -z "${ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS:-}" ] && missing="$missing ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS"
          [ -z "${ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD:-}" ] && missing="$missing ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD"
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            missing="$missing PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON"
          fi
          if [ -n "$missing" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play secrets not configured (missing:${missing}) — the Android leg skips green-neutrally until the upload keystore + Play service account secrets exist (issue #289 owner checklist)."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "All Play secrets present — dispatching the Android build+upload."

      - name: Dispatch build-mobile.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # all: build + Play upload + LISTING deploy (issue #947) — the
          # listing lane replaces the whole image set per locale + device
          # type and verifies it via edits.images.list, so the listing can
          # never trail the committed goldens by more than one train.
          # beta = the external/open testing track, mirroring the iOS leg's
          # external TestFlight group (#239 pattern).
          # Shared watcher (gh-1903 read-only wait; correlation from #343).
          # Since #359 the TestFlight
          # sibling leg fires CONCURRENTLY with this one (both needs: plan)
          # and dispatches the SAME workflow in the same minute —
          # correlation is by the child's run-name ("build-mobile
          # (all/none)" vs the sibling's "(none/all)", pinned by
          # test), never by "first run in the window", with newest-match +
          # the 30s window. Read-only wait (gh-1903): a wedged/queued run
          # is NEVER cancelled or re-dispatched — build-android/submit-
          # android's own timeout-minutes (#344) and this leg's 240m are
          # the only bounds; on leg timeout only this leg's own
          # never-started orphan child is cancelled.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-mobile.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-mobile (all/none)' \
            -f android_content=all -f android_track=beta -f ios_content=none \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  cli:
    name: 'Leg: CLI + macOS desktop'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 335m (version 20 + build-macos 150×2 — the
    # arm64 AND x86_64 matrix legs SERIALIZE on the single self-hosted
    # macOS runner — + release-macos 15); 360m leg ≥ worst-case + margin
    # (both build-macos jobs carry 150m server-side timeouts, #344). A
    # queued child — including one waiting out a sibling's full 150m
    # matrix leg — is NEVER cancelled (gh-1903); the leg timeout bounds
    # the wait and the watcher orphan-cancels only a never-started child.
    timeout-minutes: 360
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'cli')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'cli'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=cli) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      - name: Dispatch build-macos.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Children derive version themselves (latest tag + 1 at their own
          # dispatch moment) — a tag pinned here would race auto_release and
          # could attach assets to a tag pointing at a different commit.
          # Shared watcher (gh-1903 read-only wait; correlation from #343):
          # correlates OUR run by the child's run-name
          # ("build-macos (create_release=true)") so a concurrent human
          # dispatch is never adopted. A wedged self-hosted run is NEVER
          # cancelled/re-dispatched — the bounds are the build-macos jobs'
          # own 150m server-side timeouts (#344) and this leg's 360m; on
          # leg timeout the watcher orphan-cancels only this leg's own
          # never-started child.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-macos.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-macos (create_release=true)' \
            -f create_release=true \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  windows:
    name: 'Leg: Windows app'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 85m (version 20 + windows build 45 +
    # attach 20); 150m leg > worst-case + margin (the addin-leg sizing).
    timeout-minutes: 150
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'windows')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'windows'
        run: |
          exit 1

      - name: Dispatch build-windows.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The child derives the version itself (same latest-tag+1 math as
          # build-macos/build-mobile — all release children derive the SAME
          # next tag). Shared watcher (gh-1903): correlates OUR run by the
          # child's run-name, waits READ-ONLY within the child's own
          # timeout bounds, orphan-cancels only this leg's never-started
          # child on leg timeout.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-windows.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-windows (create_release=true)' \
            -f create_release=true \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  website:
    name: 'Leg: Website'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 60m (pages build 45 + deploy 15); 180m leg
    # ≫ worst-case + margin. (The old 45m leg pre-dated #351 and could not
    # even fit a healthy child + appear window — the 180m leg is the
    # #351 sizing.)
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'website')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'website'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=website) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      # pages.yml is path-filtered on push, so routine pushes (e.g. lib/
      # changes outside its filters) never redeploy — the daily guarantees
      # fa1.dev tracks main.
      - name: Dispatch pages.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Shared watcher (gh-1903 read-only wait; correlation from #343).
          # pages.yml takes no inputs, so there is no displayTitle to
          # disambiguate on — the watcher falls back to
          # newest-in-tight-window and waits read-only: no cancel, no
          # re-dispatch, bounded by the pages jobs' own timeout-minutes
          # (#344) and this leg's 180m.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh pages.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  addin:
    name: 'Leg: Outlook add-in'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 45m (single office-addin-suite job); 150m
    # leg ≫ worst-case + margin. (The old 45m leg pre-dated #351 and could
    # not even fit a healthy child + appear window — 150m is the #351
    # sizing.)
    timeout-minutes: 150
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'addin')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'addin'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=addin) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      # Acceptance suite (manifest validation, dart2js taskpane, Node +
      # Playwright e2e). The fa1.dev /outlook publish itself rides the
      # website leg — pages.yml assembles the same add-in into the deploy.
      - name: Dispatch office-addin.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Shared watcher (gh-1903 read-only wait; correlation from #343).
          # No inputs to disambiguate on (newest-in-tight-window
          # fallback); the wait is bounded by the office-addin-suite
          # job's own 45m timeout (#344) and this leg's 150m — never by a
          # watcher cancel.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh office-addin.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  # ── pub.dev leg ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # The ONLY publish path is the ci.yml tag job (pub.dev trusted publishing
  # only accepts OIDC from tag-push runs — a schedule/dispatch run can never
  # satisfy it). This leg VERIFIES pub.dev serves the pubspec version and,
  # when behind, recovers by re-running the failed tag-push publish run —
  # a rerun keeps the original push-tag event and OIDC claims, so the real
  # publish path retries. Unrecoverable states fail loudly and self-file an
  # issue with a manual-publish instruction instead of silently hanging.
  # gh-1192: a tag-publish still EXECUTING (tag pushed, ci run not visible
  # yet or queued/in_progress, tag younger than the grace window) is
  # classified «release in flight» by scripts/verify_pubdev_release.sh —
  # a neutral skip (no error, no auto-filed issue); the next scheduled
  # daily re-verifies. The 2026-10-03 collision fired the old «no ci.yml
  # run» error one minute before the healthy run completed (#1189, false
  # alarm). gh-1522: the version under test is the LATEST REMOTE TAG (the
  # committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder), so the «tag not cut
  # yet» state no longer exists.

  pubdev:
    name: 'Leg: pub.dev'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write # gh run rerun of the tag-publish run
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'pubdev')
    outputs:
      status: ${{ steps.check.outputs.status }}
      pubspec_version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.pubspec }}
      published_version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.published }}
      run_url: ${{ steps.check.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'pubdev'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=pubdev) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing published"
          exit 1

      # gh-1561: the never-triggered self-heal re-pushes the latest tag with
      # the fa-release-bot App token — a GITHUB_TOKEN push can never cascade
      # (gh-1172), the App's push can (the same mechanism ci.yml's release
      # job uses to cut tags). Job-scoped, expires with the job; this job's
      # own GITHUB_TOKEN stays read-scoped (job-level permissions block).
      # Shape mirrors the validator-proven precedent (ci.yml release job,
      # the create-github-app-token step): NO `if:` at all — secrets
      # context in a step-if trips GitHub's workflow validator; and a mint
      # on an unconfigured App (forks, rotation gap) fails, is SWALLOWED by
      # continue-on-error, outputs.token stays empty, and the script's
      # manual-re-push alarm fires exactly as before this change.
      # Least privilege, verified against the PINNED action (v3.2.0,
      # bcd2ba49 — review thread 10): the composite `permissions` input
      # does NOT exist there (action.yml defines only the generated
      # `permission-*` inputs — GitHub warns `Unexpected input(s)
      # 'permissions'` and the action never reads it; ci.yml:3980 rides
      # that warning). The HONORED ceiling is the granular
      # `permission-contents` input, which the action turns into the mint
      # request's permissions map: contents:write only — the tag re-push —
      # instead of the installation's full grant set. Without it the token
      # inherits every permission the fa-release-bot installation has.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        id: app-token
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          permission-contents: write

      - name: Verify pub.dev serves the pubspec version
        id: check
        # gh-1192: the classification (up-to-date / release-in-flight /
        # recovered + the unchanged alarms) lives in the extracted script so
        # it is shell-harness testable (test/release_flow_race_test.dart).
        # RELEASE_APP_TOKEN is empty when the mint above skipped (App not
        # configured) — the script then fails over to the manual-re-push
        # alarm instead of attempting a re-arm.
        env:
          RELEASE_APP_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: bash scripts/verify_pubdev_release.sh

  # ── Release-draft sweeper (issue #282) ────────────────────────────────────
  # Hygiene leg: no pipeline step may leave a draft release behind (the
  # 3-week-old v0.1.190 rot). The per-job guards in build-macos/build-mobile
  # own the failure path; this sweeper is the daily backstop — anything that
  # slips through (a cancelled run, a path without a guard) is deleted after
  # 24h and a deduplicated self-closing issue names the creating run so a
  # RECURRING stuck draft points at its broken step instead of rotting.
  # Runs on every daily (and manual) invocation regardless of leg results —
  # change-gating must not gate hygiene.
  sweep-drafts:
    name: Sweep stale release drafts
    needs: plan
    if: always() # even when plan failed or all legs skipped
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write # delete draft releases
      actions: read # name each swept draft's creating run (gh run list 403s without it, review of #294)
      issues: write # deduplicated self-closing sweep issue
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Delete drafts older than 24h and file the dedup issue
        run: bash scripts/sweep_stale_drafts.sh

  # ── Report + self-healing issues ─────────────────────────────────────────
  report:
    name: Summary + self-filed issues
    needs: [plan, testflight, play, pubdev, cli, website, addin]
    if: always() # runs even when plan failed, so plan failures enter the self-healing loop too
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      issues: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Job summary table and issue lifecycle
        env:
          NEXT_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.next_tag }}
          PLAN_RESULT: ${{ needs.plan.result }}
          DAILY_PUBLISH_ASSIGNEE: ai-teammate
          LEG_TESTFLIGHT: ${{ needs.testflight.result }}
          LEG_TESTFLIGHT_URL: ${{ needs.testflight.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_PLAY: ${{ needs.play.result }}
          LEG_PLAY_URL: ${{ needs.play.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_PUBDEV: ${{ needs.pubdev.result }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_STATUS: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.status }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_PUBSPEC: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.pubspec_version }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_PUBLISHED: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.published_version }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_URL: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_CLI: ${{ needs.cli.result }}
          LEG_CLI_URL: ${{ needs.cli.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_WEBSITE: ${{ needs.website.result }}
          LEG_WEBSITE_URL: ${{ needs.website.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_ADDIN: ${{ needs.addin.result }}
          LEG_ADDIN_URL: ${{ needs.addin.outputs.run_url }}

      # QUOTES the injected ::error:: line (signal-first excerpt via the
      # per-job log endpoint), not merely that an issue exists — the #1473
      # tree-noise regression class.

      # is EMPTY (the dispatch `default: none` does not apply), so gating
      # only on `!= 'none'` would run — and fail — this step every cron run.
      - name: Verify injected-failure excerpt (TEST)
        if: always() && inputs.inject_failure != '' && inputs.inject_failure != 'none'
        env:
          INJECTED: ${{ inputs.inject_failure }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          title="[daily-publish] ${INJECTED} leg failed"
          n=$(gh issue list --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --state open \
                --label daily-publish --limit 200 \
                --json number,title --jq '.[] | [.number, .title] | @tsv' \
                | while IFS=$'\t' read -r num t; do
                    [ "$t" = "$title" ] && echo "$num"
                  done | head -1)
          if [ -z "$n" ]; then
            echo "::error::inject_failure verify: no open issue titled '${title}' — the self-filing path regressed"
            exit 1
          fi
          text=$(gh issue view "$n" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
                   --json body,comments --jq '.body, (.comments[]?.body // empty)')
          if ! grep -qF "injected failure (inject_failure=${INJECTED})" <<< "$text"; then
            echo "::error::inject_failure verify: issue #${n} never quotes the injected ::error:: line — the signal-first excerpt regressed (gh-1478)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "inject_failure verify OK: issue #${n} quotes the injected error line (gh-1478)"
